views.text: In June 2024, Equity Mates noted that Australians now used services like Optus Sport, Kayo and Stan Sport to get the sports they once watched on free-to-air, highlighting Optus’ role in paid sports streaming.

episode.title: Catapult: Dominating sports analytics - how big can it get? | Company deep dive

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates explained Optus bought all 64 Women's World Cup matches for $13 million, then on-sold 15 to free-to-air, showing Optus Sport’s push into premium sports content.

episode.title: The numbers behind the Women’s World Cup ⚽

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates interviewed Optus' CEO, who described Optus as a telco delivering voice, data and fixed home internet, and as an enabler of the digital economy because connectivity had become essential to daily life.

episode.title: CEO: Kelly Bayer Rosmarin - Is 5G All It's Cracked Up To Be? | Optus

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In December 2022, Equity Mates covered the Optus data breach, where data of up to 9.8 million Australians was stolen, raising significant concerns about cybersecurity and governance for the company.

episode.title: The 6 biggest business stories of the year

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates reported reputational damage risks after the cyber attack, citing research that 56 percent of Optus customers considered switching and 10 percent had already changed providers.

episode.title: Cybersecurity is a hot topic, but is it a good investment?

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates heard that with only three operators in a continent-sized market and historic dominance by the largest player, telcos like Optus competed hard for customers to recoup heavy network investment.

episode.title: CEO: Kelly Bayer Rosmarin - Is 5G All It's Cracked Up To Be? | Optus
